title: Regional diversity of cranial skeletal stem cells governs bone morphogenetic protein-2 mediated bone regeneration
comparison_or_design: The in vitro BMP-2 osteogenic-differentiation comparison in nasal and femoral SSCs, including their matched no-BMP-2 references.
time_scope: The endpoint of the selected in vitro osteogenic differentiation assay.
excluded: Mandibular, parietal and occipital SSCs and chondrogenesis assays
Wnt5a/Box5 interventions, renal-capsule transplants, calvarial defects and baseline transcriptomics
population_or_material: Nasal- and femoral-derived skeletal stem-cell preparations in the in vitro BMP-2 osteogenesis experiment.
requested_items: SSC anatomical origin, BMP-2 versus matched control, dose and osteogenic differentiation duration
